summary.text: Jessi Cowart is the Libertarian candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A senior project manager, she says her priorities include reducing property taxes, protecting individual rights and expanding educational freedom.

paragraphs.text: Jessi Cowart earned a high school diploma from Oak Ridge High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 2003, and her career experience includes working as a senior project manager.
She advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on March 14, 2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Cowart described herself as a lifelong Montgomery County resident, mother and longtime advocate for individual liberty and limited government.
She said her key messages are lowering taxes and limiting government, protecting individual liberty, and putting constituents ahead of partisan politics.
She said she has drafted the Texas Automated License Plate Reader Prohibition Act and is also focused on property tax relief.
She said she is endorsed by the Texas Forward Party.
